claims.claim: The application runs its agent harness locally and can use user-selected model providers.
Commander, Manager, Specialist, and Worker organization roles can govern typed delegation without granting tool permissions.
Consequential delegated tasks can use task contracts, deterministic acceptance checks, bounded revisions, and optional independent audit.
Control Mode exposes evidence-backed read-only agent, memory-provenance, approval, action, cost, and provider-signal surfaces without inventing unavailable runtime state.
Derivative orchestration does not bypass the inherited capability, consent, permission, or E-STOP boundaries.
The derivative does not use StarNet upstream release or update infrastructure.
Public builds update through a Moe AI Station controlled and signed release channel.
Distributed builds contain no StarNet-protected name, logo, station artwork, or misleading publisher identity.
Existing compatible workspace/state data survives the future application identifier migration.
